soru: İçerik dağıtım ağlarında önbellekleme ile birleşen güvenli kodlanmış önbellekleme (gizlilik ve güvenlik garantileri) üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: İçerik dağıtım ağlarında önbellekleme ile birleşen güvenli kodlanmış önbellekleme (gizlilik ve güvenlik garantileri) üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-02-11. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Fundamental Limits of Caching
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced the Maddah-Ali–Niesen coded caching model and scheme; every later secure and private coded caching scheme builds on it.

calismalar.baslik: Fundamental Limits of Caching with Secure Delivery
calismalar.gerekce: First characterization of the memory-rate trade-off for coded caching with secure delivery against an external eavesdropper, using one-time-pad keys placed in caches.

calismalar.baslik: Private Coded Caching
calismalar.gerekce: Defined secretive/private coded caching, where users learn nothing about files they did not request, and gave an order-optimal scheme using secret sharing.

calismalar.baslik: On Coded Caching with Private Demands
calismalar.gerekce: Set up the information-theoretic demand-privacy model and introduced the virtual-users and MDS/privacy-key approaches that later work builds on.

calismalar.baslik: Fundamental Limits of Demand-Private Coded Caching
calismalar.gerekce: Main reference for demand privacy: general constructions from non-private schemes, order-optimality results, and the exact trade-off for N>=K=2.

calismalar.baslik: Key Superposition Simultaneously Achieves Security and Privacy in Cache-Aided Linear Function Retrieval
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that superposing security and privacy keys achieves content security and demand privacy together, with little added cost and near-optimal performance.

calismalar.baslik: Fundamental Limits of Caching for Demand Privacy against Colluding Users
calismalar.gerekce: Gives a privacy-key scheme and a new converse for demand privacy against any colluding set of users, within a constant gap of optimal in all regimes.

calismalar.baslik: Demand Private Coded Caching
calismalar.gerekce: Early paper on demand-private coded caching showing that a non-private scheme with NK users yields a private scheme with an order-optimality guarantee.

calismalar.baslik: Demand-Private Coded Caching and the Exact Trade-off for N=K=2
calismalar.gerekce: First exact memory-rate trade-off under information-theoretic demand privacy (two users, two files), including a privacy-specific converse.

calismalar.baslik: Device-to-Device Secure Coded Caching
calismalar.gerekce: Extends secure delivery and secure caching to D2D networks using secret sharing and one-time pads, with bounds whose gap vanishes as memory grows.

calismalar.baslik: Combination Networks with or without Secrecy Constraints: The Impact of Caching Relays
calismalar.gerekce: Studies secure delivery and secure caching in two-hop combination networks with caching relays, showing how network topology affects secrecy-constrained performance.

calismalar.baslik: Secrecy Capacity-Memory Tradeoff of Erasure Broadcast Channels
calismalar.gerekce: Combines joint cache-channel coding with wiretap coding and shows receiver caches allow positive secrecy capacity even against a stronger eavesdropper.

calismalar.baslik: On the Fundamental Limits of Device-to-Device Private Caching under Uncoded Cache Placement and User Collusion
calismalar.gerekce: Gives order-optimal demand-private schemes and converses for D2D caching with colluding users.

calismalar.baslik: Coded Caching with Private Demands and Caches
calismalar.gerekce: Makes both demands and cache contents private, linking private coded caching to PIR and reducing subpacketization.

calismalar.baslik: On Secure Coded Caching via Combinatorial Method
calismalar.gerekce: Introduces secure placement delivery arrays, a combinatorial framework for low-subpacketization schemes with content security and demand privacy.

calismalar.baslik: Coded Caching in the Presence of a Wire and a Cache Tapping Adversary of Type II
calismalar.gerekce: Handles an adversary who can tap both the placement and delivery phases, and finds the strong secrecy capacity in the two-user, two-file case.

calismalar.baslik: The Wiretap Channel with a Cache
calismalar.gerekce: Characterizes the wiretap channel with a receiver cache and shows a cache makes secure communication possible even over a degraded main channel.

calismalar.baslik: The Capacity of Cache Aided Private Information Retrieval
calismalar.gerekce: Finds the exact capacity of cache-aided PIR, connecting caching with privacy of user requests.

calismalar.baslik: Fundamental Limits of Cache-Aided Private Information Retrieval with Unknown and Uncoded Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: Characterizes cache-aided PIR when the side information is uncoded and unknown to the databases, a key link between caching and PIR.

calismalar.baslik: Subpacketization in Coded Caching with Demand Privacy
calismalar.gerekce: First systematic study of subpacketization under demand privacy, using PDA-based lifting constructions and impossibility results.

calismalar.baslik: Optimal Demand Private Coded Caching for Users with Small Buffers
calismalar.gerekce: Gives the exact demand-private trade-off in the small-memory regime and points out that the general (K,N) case is still open.

calismalar.baslik: Multi-Access Coded Caching with Demand Privacy
calismalar.gerekce: Extends demand privacy to multi-access caching networks with cyclic wrap-around, using a lifting construction and privacy keys.

calismalar.baslik: Security and Privacy in Cache-Aided Linear Function Retrieval for Multi-access Coded Caching
calismalar.gerekce: Brings content security, demand privacy and linear function retrieval together in multi-access combinatorial topologies, generalizing key superposition.

calismalar.baslik: Secretive Coded Caching with Shared Caches
calismalar.gerekce: Extends secretive coded caching to shared-cache (helper) networks like edge or CDN caches, and shows each user needs a private cache.

calismalar.baslik: Secretive Coded Caching from PDAs
calismalar.gerekce: Cuts the exponential subpacketization of secretive coded caching by building schemes from placement delivery arrays.

calismalar.baslik: Secure Coded Caching with Colluding Users
calismalar.gerekce: Requires that coalitions of colluding users pooling their caches learn nothing about unrequested files, strengthening secretive caching.

calismalar.baslik: Demand Privacy in Hotplug Caching Systems
calismalar.gerekce: Adds demand privacy to hotplug systems where some users are offline during delivery, a practical CDN concern.

calismalar.baslik: On Coded Caching Systems with Offline Users, with and without Demand Privacy against Colluding Users
calismalar.gerekce: Develops achievability and converse results for offline-user systems with and without privacy against colluding users.

calismalar.baslik: Demand Private Coded Caching: Small Cache Size
calismalar.gerekce: Recent work giving new optimal demand-private trade-offs at small cache sizes, part of the push toward the open exact trade-off.

calismalar.baslik: A Secretive Coded Caching for Shared Cache Systems using PDAs
calismalar.gerekce: Gives low-subpacketization secretive schemes for shared-cache systems via PDAs, with a cut-set lower bound.
